name: Text2KGBench
description: A benchmark to evaluate language models' ability to generate knowledge graphs from natural language text guided by an ontology. It assesses fact extraction, ontology conformance, and hallucination detection using two datasets with multiple ontologies and sentences.
reputation: A specialized and relatively new benchmark in knowledge graph generation that has seen limited but growing use in ontology-guided text-to-KG evaluation.
notes: Provides two datasets: Wikidata-TekGen and DBpedia-WebNLG; baseline results show room for improvement.
